description: Mars rovers exploring terrain, taking samples and images
layout: Grid-like terrain with waypoints, rovers navigate between them
legend: Show rover states, sample locations, and communication status

critical_relations.at: rover at waypoint means rover is at that waypoint location
critical_relations.at_soil_sample: waypoint at_soil_sample means soil sample available at waypoint
critical_relations.at_rock_sample: waypoint at_rock_sample means rock sample available at waypoint
critical_relations.have_soil_analysis: rover have_soil_analysis waypoint means rover analyzed soil from waypoint
critical_relations.have_rock_analysis: rover have_rock_analysis waypoint means rover analyzed rock from waypoint
critical_relations.have_image: rover have_image objective mode means rover captured image
critical_relations.communicated_soil_data: waypoint communicated_soil_data means soil data was transmitted
critical_relations.communicated_rock_data: waypoint communicated_rock_data means rock data was transmitted
critical_relations.communicated_image_data: objective communicated_image_data means image data was transmitted
critical_relations.can_traverse: rover can_traverse wp1 wp2 means rover can move between waypoints
critical_relations.visible: objective visible waypoint means objective is visible from waypoint

positioning_rules: Waypoints should be arranged in a grid or network layout
Rovers should be drawn at their current waypoint
Show sample locations with distinct markers
Indicate communicated data with visual feedback (checkmarks, colors)
